column1: # Forever loot of Shadowfang Keep (map 33): the boss drop and quest reward rows (spec jvbastel/WOWAI#240, ticket
# #245). The items are in loot_shadowfang_keep_items.tsv. The layout of the loot files is in forever/REFRESH.md,
# "Dungeon loot". forever/generator writes a drop row into forever_creature_loot_template: a copy of every stock row
# of the boss's creature loot plus the new row, outside the stock equal-chance group, with patch_min 0 (Shadowfang
# Keep is open from patch 0). A reward row becomes a forever_quest_template copy of the stock quest with the Forever
# reward choices.
# Sources, read 2026-10-31: Wowhead's Forever tooltip data ("Dropped by" and "Drop Chance" of each item,
# https://nether.wowhead.com/tooltip/item/<id>?dataEnv=16&locale=0) and the Forever quest pages
# (https://www.wowhead.com/forever/quest=<id>, read with a web-fetch tool: notes/forever/dungeon-loot-research.md 7.3).
# A drop is confirmed when the tooltip's "Dropped by" names the boss; its chance is the tooltip's "Drop Chance".
# Quests 1014 (Arugal Must Die) and 1740 (The Orb of Soran'ruk) show the stock rewards on Wowhead Forever: no row
# (their reward items have Forever stats in the items file; 1740 keeps its Warlock lock). 95036 A Moon-Kissed Blade is
# a Forever-only quest with no reward items shown: out of scope.
# Stock boss drops keep their stock chance (spec #240): their references and Rethilgore's Rugged Spaulders have no row.
# Not built: Blueprint: Tanning Rack (273096, Razorclaw the Butcher 0.34 %) and Blueprint: Toxin Study (273105,
# Commander Springvale 0.32 %), confirmed drops of Forever campsite features that 1.12 has no meaning for.
# Columns (tab-separated):
#   kind        drop: a new item on a boss; reward: a new reward choice of a quest (replaces "-") or a swapped one;
#               unlock: the quest reward item loses its class lock (the item needs a row in the items file)
#   item        the item ID (a row of a loot items file, or a stock item)
#   name        the item name
#   target      drop: the boss (creature entry); reward, unlock: the quest ID
#   targetName  the stock name of the boss or the title of the quest (the generator compares it)
#   loot        drop: "creature" (the boss's creature loot entry) or "reference <ID>" (a reference loot entry that only
#               this boss uses); else "-"
#   chance      drop: the drop chance in percent; else "-"
#   replaces    reward: the stock reward choice it replaces, "-" to add it in the first empty choice slot, or "fixed":
#               the stock fixed reward item becomes a choice (first empty choice slot) and leaves the fixed rewards;
#               else "-"
#   count       reward: the number of items; else "-"
#   status      confirmed, unconfirmed or unreadable (the generator leaves the row out and lists it)
#   source      a Wowhead URL, or "client <build>"
#   date        the day the source was read, YYYY-MM-DD
#   notes
